rows.note: Use this for financial gain or profit, especially in business or trade.

example.english: This company recorded a substantial gain this year.
example.traditional: 呢間公司今年錄得可觀利潤。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 luk6 dak1 ho2 gun1 lei6 jeon6

rows.note: Use this for financial returns or income gained from an investment or activity.

example.english: This fund is expected to provide a steady gain.
example.traditional: 買呢隻基金，預期可以有穩定收益。
example.jyutping: maai5 ni1 zek3 gei1 gam1 jyu6 kei4 ho2 ji5 jau5 wan2 ding6 sau1 jik1

rows.note: Use this for the benefits or results one has gained from an effort or experience.

example.english: I gain a lot from this exchange trip.
example.traditional: 今次交流團令我收穫好大。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 gaau1 lau4 tyun4 ling6 ngo5 sau1 wok6 hou2 daai6

rows.note: Use this for a benefit or advantage gained rather than a concrete acquisition.

example.english: I gain a lot from the doctor's explanation.
example.traditional: 聽完醫生講解，我真係得益不少。
example.jyutping: teng1 jyun4 ji1 saang1 gong2 gaai2 ngo5 zan1 hai6 dak1 jik1 bat1 siu2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for acquiring or receiving something.

example.english: I finally gain possession of the prize.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 dak1 dou2 fan6 zoeng2 ban2

rows.note: Use this for an amount, level, skill, or strength becoming greater rather than for gaining possession.

example.english: Working out can help you gain muscle.
example.jyutping: zou6 wan6 dung6 ho2 ji5 zang1 gaa1 gei1 juk6

rows.note: Use this when “gain” means make progress or improve, especially in ability or performance, not when it means gain possession.

example.english: With more practice, you gain ground in English more quickly.
example.traditional: 你多啲練習，英文就會進步得快啲。
example.jyutping: nei5 do1 di1 lin6 zaap6 jing1 man4 zau6 wui5 zeon3 bou6 dak1 faai3 di1

rows.note: Use this specifically for putting on body weight.

example.english: When winter comes, I eat more and gain weight.
example.traditional: 一到冬天，我食多咗就增磅。
example.jyutping: jat1 dou3 dung1 tin1 ngo5 sik6 do1 zo2 zau6 zang1 bong2
